diff --git a/src/click/angle_optional_argument.py b/src/click/angle_optional_argument.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..72c710c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/click/angle_optional_argument.py
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from .core import Argument
+from .core import Context
+
+
+class AngleOptionalArgument(Argument):
+    """An argument that displays optional metavars in angle brackets."""
+
+    def make_metavar(self, ctx: Context) -> str:
+        if self.metavar is not None:
+            return self.metavar
+        var = self.type.get_metavar(param=self, ctx=ctx)
+        if not var:
+            var = self.name.upper()  # type: ignore
+        if self.deprecated:
+            var += "!"
+        if not self.required:
+            var = f"<{var}>"
+        if self.nargs != 1:
+            var += "..."
+        return var
diff --git a/tests/test_angle_optional_argument.py b/tests/test_angle_optional_argument.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1f4bc2d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_angle_optional_argument.py
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+import pytest
+
+import click
+from click.angle_optional_argument import AngleOptionalArgument
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("attrs", "expected"),
+    [
+        ({}, "VALUE"),
+        ({"required": False}, "<VALUE>"),
+        ({"nargs": -1, "deprecated": True}, "<VALUE!>..."),
+        ({"nargs": 2}, "VALUE..."),
+        ({"type": click.Choice(["a", "b"])}, "{a|b}"),
+        ({"required": False, "type": click.Choice(["a", "b"])}, "<[a|b]>"),
+        ({"nargs": -1, "deprecated": True, "metavar": "[CUSTOM]"}, "[CUSTOM]"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_make_metavar(attrs, expected):
+    arg = AngleOptionalArgument(["value"], **attrs)
+    ctx = click.Context(click.Command("test"))
+    assert arg.make_metavar(ctx) == expected
notes:
The override keeps Click's metavar logic and replaces only the optional argument's outer delimiters. Added coverage for required arguments, choices, custom metavars, deprecation, and arity.
